sentences.text: It has been submitted on behalf of the petitioners that there is no allegation of tampering of witnesses alleged against the petitioners.
The petitioners have falsely been implicated in the present case.
On the earlier occasion also, a case was instituted by the victim against the petitioners.
There is no substantive evidence in support of the offence under Section 328 of I.P.C.
Except for offence under Section 328 of I.P.C., rest of the offences are triable by the Magistrate.

The petitioner No.1 is father-in-law, petitioner No.2 is mother-in-law, petitioner No.3 is Gotani, petitioner No.4 is Bhaisur,
petitioner No.5 is Devar, petitioner No.6 is Gotani, petitioner No.7 is Nandoi and petitioner No.8 is Nanad of the victim.

The petitioners have relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md.
Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3)
PLJR 182.

sentences.text: On behalf of the State, it is submitted that the petitioners are named in the complaint case/F.I.R.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioners, above named, in the event of arrest/surrender before Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.27180 of 2023(2) dt.21-06-2023 the learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Court below/concerned Court in connection with Chenari P.S. case No.355/2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The petitioners are directed to co-operate during the trial.
If the petitioners do not co-operate during the trial, the court below will be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioners.

If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
In case, any such application is made by either of the parties, the court below shall refer the matter to the District Mediation Centre.

(Sudhir Singh, J) Narendra/-
